full_judgment: 5. Social Marketing Company, whose product is "Orsaline" has filed Title Suit No. 22 of 1995 under section 73 of the Trade Marks Act, 1940 before the District Judge, Dhaka for permanent injunction restraining the defendant, said Universal Pharmaceuticals Ltd. from marketing and selling their product using the Trade Mark "Oralsaline" and to withdraw all products of them from the market and also for a decree for compensation. On 1-4-1995, an order of ad-interim injunction was granted on the prayer of the plaintiff Social Marketing Company by the Additional District Judge, 6th Court, Dhaka where the suit is pending, restraining the defendants from marketing and selling their product said "Oralsaline". The said order of ad-interim injunction on contest was made absolute on 14-11-1995 by the impugned judgment and order, directing the defendant, now the appellant, not to use the resembling trade mark of the plaintiff which is Orsaline till disposal of the suit.
